description: This file defines time-related types and functions for the Prometheus project, including a custom Time type, interval struct, and duration parsing utilities.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A custom type representing milliseconds since epoch, excluding leap seconds.

classes.name: Interval
classes.description: Represents a time interval with start and end Times.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: A wrapper around time.Duration for custom parsing and serialization.

methods.name: Now
methods.description: Returns the current time as a Time.

methods.name: TimeFromUnix
methods.description: Creates a Time from Unix seconds.

methods.name: TimeFromUnixNano
methods.description: Creates a Time from Unix nanoseconds.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks if two Times are equal.

methods.name: Before
methods.description: Checks if a Time is before another.

methods.name: After
methods.description: Checks if a Time is after another.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a duration to a Time.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts a Time from another, returning a duration.

methods.name: Time
methods.description: Converts a Time to a time.Time object.

methods.name: Unix
methods.description: Returns the Unix seconds representation of a Time.

methods.name: UnixNano
methods.description: Returns the Unix nanoseconds representation of a Time.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Time.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes Time to JSON.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes Time from JSON.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a Duration from a string.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type name for Duration.

methods.name: ParseDuration
methods.description: Parses a string into a Duration, assuming big-to-small unit order.

methods.name: ParseDurationAllowNegative
methods.description: Parses a string into a Duration, allowing negative values.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of Duration.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes Duration to JSON.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes Duration from JSON.

methods.name: MarshalText
methods.description: Serializes Duration to text.

methods.name: UnmarshalText
methods.description: Deserializes Duration from text.

methods.name: MarshalYAML
methods.description: Serializes Duration to YAML.

methods.name: UnmarshalYAML
methods.description: Deserializes Duration from YAML.
